critic: design-critic agent (sonnet), blind: sheets + candidate metrics only, 2026-10-19
reads_as_reason: It reads as a stack of rounded boxes (box head, slab chest, block thighs and shanks) with wing-like arms, so it looks like a hard-point massing, not a finished adult product.

G1.evidence: The head is a flat-topped, near-square block almost as wide as the chest block (front clay view). The torso is a stacked box with a hard black gap under the shoulder block. The neck is a stub (P2a = 0.1037 hu, FAIL). The arms are heavy flared slabs wider than the torso. Together this gives a chunky, toy-like block-figure gestalt.

G2.evidence: Chest, waist and pelvis are separate stacked slabs with horizontal ledges (front and side clay views). The side silhouette steps in and out at the chest, mid-torso block and rear block. Thigh and shank are rectangular blocks with a pinched knee, and the arms have stepped bumps. The dark gaps look like leftover gaps between boxes, not designed recesses. Metrics agree: S3a ledges = 8 (FAIL), S3b leg bumps = 6 (FAIL).

G3.evidence: The sheet is single-tone clay with no shell/recess/accent assignment, so two-tone discipline cannot be judged.

G4.evidence: Radii and squareness are inconsistent. The head, chest and thigh blocks are near-square with small corner radii. The feet are soft ovals. The arms are faceted tapered wedges with ripples. The rear back and battery boxes are hard cuboids.

G6.evidence: In the equal-height lineup it does not share the optimus_like / human_canon silhouette. Matches: head height and the leg height split (P1, P6, P7 pass). Does not match: the shoulder and arm mass is far wider and boxier (P3 = 0.3644 vs band 0.22-0.29, FAIL), the neck is almost absent (P2a FAIL), the pelvis is wide (P5 = 1.1319 vs band 0.62-0.9, FAIL), the legs are straight blocks with no taper, and the feet are long (P10a = 0.1922, FAIL). The references have a smooth S-curve flank; this design has stepped ledges.

pairwise.evidence: The two sheets are near-identical in design language, so the preference is weak. At equal height the 600 candidate has a slightly narrower arm and shoulder flare than the 550 baseline, and its front silhouette is a little less winged and closer to the reference outlines. The baseline's arms spread further and its torso looks more squat. No baseline metrics were provided, so this is a look-only judgement.

top_changes.change: Lengthen the visible neck and slim the head so it reads as a capsule, not a block. Raise the neck length toward the 0.18-0.55 band and narrow the neck-to-head transition.

Cut the shoulder and arm span toward the 0.22-0.29 band. Round the shoulder block into a capsule and taper the upper arm. Narrow the pelvis and thigh block toward the 0.62-0.9 band relative to the shoulder.
top_changes.profile_param: segments[torso].stations[shoulder].w; segments[arm_l/r].stations[*].w; segments[torso].stations[pelvis].w and glute_l/r width

top_changes.change: Blend the chest, waist and pelvis stations into one continuous profile to remove ledges. Give each leg segment a single monotone taper without mid-segment bumps. Make the neck, waist and knee gaps deliberate and uniform.

notes: Both sheets are unstyled hard-point massings, so G3 cannot be judged and G1/G4 are judged on form only. P8 is NA in the metrics, but the legs look untapered. No baseline metrics were provided, so the pairwise call is look-only.
